The first 14 days matter most

What to do after a Florida car accident

  1. 01

    See a doctor within 14 days

    Florida's PIP law requires care within 14 days to keep your benefits — even if you feel fine.

  2. 02

    Document everything

    Photos of the scene, damage, and injuries. Get the police report number and the other driver's insurance.

  3. 03

    Call before you settle

    Insurance may lowball you with an early offer — often far below what a claim is worth. A free review shows where you stand, and we can help you get it.

Good to know

Common questions

How much does it cost to hire you?+

Nothing upfront. The review is always free.

I already feel fine — do I still need a doctor?+

Injuries like whiplash appear days later, and Florida requires care within 14 days for personal injury protection.

The insurance company already called me. What do I say?+

You do not have to give a statement. Talk to an attorney first.

How long do I have to file a claim in Florida?+

2 years for motor vehicle accidents on/after March 24, 2023. Some are shorter — don't wait.

What if the accident was partly my fault?+

Florida uses comparative negligence. A quick review tells you where you stand.
